about_the_game:
Once upon a time a long, long time ago ... Among others, 1991 wrote C. Borgmeier from the magazine "Amiga Joker":

"Nomen est Omen - it may be puzzled again. For a change this time it's not about little stones, instead there are marbles, tubes, discs and lots of tinkering fun ... " - "... If you add in the high addiction factor, there can only be one conclusion: Logical is one of the most beautiful action puzzle games for a long time - an absolute must for friends of the genre".

But away with the musty dust. It's time for Logical Now! - Many discs - One color - Many explosions ... and off to the next level!

Contemporary 3D Graphics

Now in 3D rendering, with lights, shadows and great explosions!

Sound and Music

In High Quality and Even In Stereo!

Fresh Levels

Newly created levels, now with even more playing surface!

New Game Elements

Besides the known, there are many new modules in the game. How about "Master Mind" Turnwheels, for example? Guess which color combination explodes! Or a few switches and walls? - Let yourself be surprised!

You like games like Tetris? Then try the Demo of Logical Now! But be careful! This puzzle action game is supposed to be addictive - Be warned! :)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/8.1/10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 460 or AMD ATI Radeon HD 5750
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9 sound device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/8.1/10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5 series or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 560 or AMD ATI Radeon HD 5870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9 sound device

short_description: Away with the musty dust of the old but still classic game Logical from 1991. It's time for Logical Now! - Many discs - One color - Many explosions ... and off to the next level! With new sound, 3D-graphic, levels and new game features!
